description: This file defines the Config class for the HTML format in the Daux documentation generator. It extends BaseConfig and provides methods to access various configuration options like GitHub URL, search, analytics, navigation, and theme settings.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A configuration class for the HTML format, extending BaseConfig, providing methods to retrieve various configuration options specific to the documentation setup.

methods.name: prepareGithubUrl
methods.description: Prepares and normalizes a GitHub URL for editing links, ensuring HTTPS and correct basepath.

methods.name: getEditOn
methods.description: Returns the URL configuration for editing content on GitHub, considering custom configurations.

methods.name: hasSearch
methods.description: Checks if search functionality is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: showDateModified
methods.description: Determines if the 'date modified' timestamp should be shown.

methods.name: showPreviousNextLinks
methods.description: Determines whether to display previous/next navigation links.

methods.name: showCodeToggle
methods.description: Checks if the toggle for showing code blocks is enabled.

methods.name: hasAutomaticTableOfContents
methods.description: Checks if automatic table of contents generation is enabled.

methods.name: hasGoogleAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Google Analytics is configured.

methods.name: getGoogleAnalyticsId
methods.description: Returns the Google Analytics ID.

methods.name: hasPlausibleAnalyticsDomain
methods.description: Checks if a Plausible analytics domain is configured.

methods.name: getPlausibleAnalyticsDomain
methods.description: Returns the Plausible analytics domain.

methods.name: hasPiwikAnalytics
methods.description: Checks if Piwik analytics is configured.

methods.name: getPiwikAnalyticsId
methods.description: Returns the Piwik analytics ID.

methods.name: getPiwikAnalyticsUrl
methods.description: Returns the Piwik analytics URL.

methods.name: hasPoweredBy
methods.description: Checks if a 'powered by' message is set.

methods.name: getPoweredBy
methods.description: Returns the 'powered by' message.

methods.name: hasTwitterHandles
methods.description: Checks if Twitter handles are configured.

methods.name: getTwitterHandles
methods.description: Returns the Twitter handles.

methods.name: hasLinks
methods.description: Checks if links are configured.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Returns the configured links.

methods.name: hasRepository
methods.description: Checks if a repository link is configured.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the repository URL.

methods.name: hasButtons
methods.description: Checks if buttons are configured.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Returns the button configurations.

methods.name: hasLandingPage
methods.description: Checks if a landing page is enabled.

methods.name: hasBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Checks if breadcrumbs are enabled.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbsSeparator
methods.description: Returns the separator string for breadcrumbs.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Returns the configured theme.

methods.name: hasThemeVariant
methods.description: Checks if a theme variant is set.

methods.name: getThemeVariant
methods.description: Returns the theme variant.
